packageVersionPolicy: ProgramKit packages use the exact repository version 0.1.0-alpha.1. Floating ranges and build-output identities are forbidden.

any changed bytes require a new proposal; incompatible change requires migration

provider ownership, proposal, configuration, package, executable, schema, operation, and evidence digests

rows.changeRule: provider version and authoritative-source observation are evidence; material contract drift blocks

migrationPolicy: Every changed registration input produces a deterministic diff and requires explicit proposal-digest acceptance.
Compatible additions never silently enter an existing provider registration.
An incompatible contract, schema, protocol, package, bridge, or provider configuration change requires a reviewed migration or exact removal followed by fresh registration.
No automatic upgrade, feed publication, provider mutation, or source/build coupling is permitted.
